title: The net-watch early-exit check in verify-prod-untouched cannot fire
severity_rationale: S4, equal to the estimate: a redundant check, the deadline covers it.

evidence.note: a synchronous loop never lets the child exit code update, so the early check cannot run; the 60 s deadline still applies

sibling_sites_checked: The sampler has an independent 60 s deadline, so a dead sampler still fails the run.
recommendation: Poll with an async wait, or drop the dead branch.
